technical_stack.mobility_envelope: proposed low-speed geofenced robot; exact platform, speed and route require professional confirmation
localisation: geofence monitored independently from route planner
decision: no autonomous expansion of route or operating hours
safety: public path remains outside the machine envelope
logging: no image retention in this tabletop

rights_boundary.non_ai_path: A continuous ordinary accessible route remains open; staff use a printed detour and incident card if the test layer closes.
rights_boundary.retention: Synthetic in-memory fixture states are deleted after evidence generation; schema, empty fixtures and aggregate results remain.

fixtures.condition: ordinary pedestrian remains outside the machine envelope
fixtures.expected_action: continue at the proposed bounded speed under staff observation

fixtures.condition: wheelchair user approaches the crossing priority zone
fixtures.expected_action: robot yields and reaches a minimum-risk stop before the priority zone

fixtures.condition: child or older person crosses unexpectedly inside the bounded fixture
fixtures.expected_action: independent emergency stop, human takeover and failed-test record

fixtures.condition: network and route-planner outputs become unavailable
fixtures.expected_action: minimum-risk stop, isolate tools, switch to staffed ordinary route and restore the test pocket

human_gates.question: Can it work safely inside a bounded test envelope?
human_gates.candidate_owner: authorized test-site operator with independent safety reviewer

human_gates.question: Are version, licence, limits, reproduction and accountable owner fit for public release?
human_gates.candidate_owner: authorized release steward with rights and accessibility reviewers

human_gates.question: Does informed public use justify continuation without harming non-participants?
human_gates.candidate_owner: authorized public-space operator with user and community reviewers

stop_conditions: robot crosses the machine envelope or enters the ordinary accessible route
physical or staffed emergency stop is unavailable
unapproved personal data, biometrics or external connection appears
complaint, collision, near miss or accessibility obstruction is not closed by a human decision
return_actions: stop and isolate the robot and route-planning tools
keep the ordinary accessible route open under staffed or printed guidance
freeze the minimum incident state and delete prohibited or expired data
remove temporary barriers and restore the test pocket to ordinary public use
issue a Return Record and require a new Test Receipt before any later gate

decision.reason: Only a synthetic, disconnected tabletop may run. Official geometry, site survey, platform specification, accountable operator, permits, insurance and real takeover capacity are absent.
